description: Long-press the screen at coordinates. Instead of pixels you can pass screen percentages (0-1): safer when estimating positions from a screenshot image.

durationMs.description: Press duration (default 1000ms — launchers ignore shorter holds)

serial.description: Device serial (defaults to session or the only device)

xPct.description: X as fraction of screen width (0-1)

yPct.description: Y as fraction of screen height (0-1)

name: long_press
title: Long press
